text:
release-manager: Heads up — code freeze in 90m for the 2.14.x branch. I have one late-merge exception request: tiny version bump + changelog entry for the serialization fix in telemetry (PR #5123). Asking for quick sign-off and a short canary if CI looks good.

maria: What does the bump change exactly? Is this just packaging metadata or a behavior change?

kevin: It's a patch bump only. No API changes; fixes a serde edge-case where empty KV arrays caused a deserialization panic. Unit tests added, e2e smoke passed locally. CI running now.

deploy-bot: CI status for PR #5123 — build: ✅, unit_tests: ✅, integration: running (30m ETA).

carla: If integration is still running, we can do a small canary on staging with the previous runtime flag turned on. I can run the canary at +30m.

jamal: I can give sign-off if you can confirm there are no model-serving infra compatibility issues. Which components touch runtime serialization?

kevin: Only the config marshal/unmarshal when loading model routing metadata. No runtime kernel changes. I ran a local staging simulation against the canary model table and it was fine.

maria: Ok, I need a one-line changelog for release notes. Something like: "Fix deserialization crash for empty KV arrays in telemetry routing metadata (patch)."

release-manager: Perfect. Kevin — can you push the changelog line and the bump, request auto-merge on green, and ping back here when integration ✅? If integration passes and Carla's canary is green, Jamal, can you +1 for exception so I can approve the freeze override?

kevin: Pushed. PR now has changelog entry and version bump. Requested auto-merge on green.

deploy-bot: CI status for PR #5123 — integration: ✅.

carla: Canary run started against staging cluster c7 with 5% traffic, no errors after 45m. Logs: ``[router] serde: handled empty KV array``. Going to bump to 20% for 15m.

jamal: Reviewed logs and canary telemetry. No regressions observed. +1 from me for late-merge exception.

release-manager: Thanks all. I approved the override and merged PR #5123. Noting in the release board and will add exception rationale. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — updating release notes and tagging the changelog entry in the candidate.

kevin: Rollout schedule: will go to prod in the next maintenance window unless we see new telemetry. I'll monitor.

release-manager: Closing thread — appreciate the quick turnaround.
